text:
Riya (People Ops): Heads-up: Maya starts Mon. I put together a compact manager+HR onboarding loop — goal is to make week0 frictionless and set clear 30/60/90 outcomes. Quick eyes, please.

Carlos (Eng Manager): Looks good. My priority: get Maya into the dev loop and shipping a tiny fix by EOW. Will assign a low-risk issue she can own.

Ethan (HR): Sharing our micro-30/60/90 framework: each window = 2 measurable outcomes + one skill focus. Prefer short bullets so managers can iterate. Day3 benefits hangout is still standard.

Tanya (IT): Device question: MacBook Pro or Lenovo? Also need preferred delivery address and phone for 2FA SMS fallback.

Maya (New Hire): MacBook Pro is preferable. Address matches offer. Happy to set up SMS fallback.

OnboardBot: Welcome Maya! :tada: Created onboarding checklist: Device order, Slack/GH invites, payroll forms, security training. Auto reminders: device follow-up in 48h; training reminder in 6d.

Riya (People Ops): Manager checklist proposal (compact):
- Day0 (pre-9am): confirm device + Okta invite sent. 30-min intro call at 10am.
- Day0 (afternoon): quick environment walkthrough + pair with buddy.
- Day1: join team standup, take onboarding issue, meet product & infra.
- Day2: guided pairing on CI + logging.
- Day3: benefits & payroll 1:1 with HR (Ethan).
- EOW: 30-min sync to align 30/60/90 and capture blockers.

Carlos (Eng Manager): I'll add: weekly 1:1 starting week0; biweekly skip if remote? No, keep weekly. Also will post a "good first issue" and assign buddy (Sam from infra).

Ethan (HR): HR checklist additions:
- Send payroll & tax packet day0; confirm direct deposit day1.
- Benefits overview (20 min) day3 + link to enrollment form.
- Compliance training (Security + Data Handling) to be started by EOW.

Tanya (IT): Access plan I'm provisioning: 
```
- Okta (SAML)
- Slack (eng, people-ops, product)
- GitHub (org: contrib + onboarding repo)
- Jira (project: platform)
- VPN + internal wiki access
- Email + calendar
```
I'll create temp credentials if device is delayed.

Carlos (Eng Manager): 30/60/90 phrasing I'll use (outcome-first):
- 30-day: dev env ready + merged onboarding PR (metric: PR merged, review feedback addressed)
- 60-day: deliver a small user-facing tweak with CI green (metric: story shipped + post-deploy check)
- 90-day: lead a retro on the feature and propose one improvement (metric: proposal + implementation plan)
These are intentionally outcome-oriented and measurable.

Ethan (HR): Agree. We'll include these as suggested goals in the kickoff 1:1 so Maya and Carlos can tailor them. Also please note: benefits enrollment window closes in 30 days; remind by day28.

Riya (People Ops): A few operational asks:
- Carlos: send calendar invites for all onboarding blocks.
- Tanya: expedite badge if Maya plans to visit HQ within 7 days.
- Carlos: confirm EOW success criteria (what counts as "onboarded").

Carlos (Eng Manager): EOW success = Slack joined, dev env functional, onboarding PR opened or merged, compliance training started. If any blocker persists, escalate to Riya.

Tanya (IT): Badge request placed (standard). If HQ visit sooner, I can do a 48-hour expedite.

Maya (New Hire): Got invites and GH access. Thanks for the quick turnaround. Excited to start! :smile: 

OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: GH invite follow-up in 24h; compliance training nudges on day4 & day6.

Riya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Once Carlos posts the "welcome-maya" issue I'll mark this thread resolved in the tracker. :thumbsup:

Carlos (Eng Manager): Posted issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard/issues/31 — includes checklist & first PR task.

Tanya (IT): Okta + GitHub invites sent. Device order confirmed.

Ethan (HR): Payroll packet sent to Maya; benefits email scheduled for day3.

Maya (New Hire): All received. Appreciate the clear plan — see you Monday! :wave:
